cliente_que_paga: RevOps manager at a manufacturer using HubSpot
problema: Sales reps quote custom parts by hand from CAD files and re-key data into deals.
solucion: HubSpot app that parses uploaded STEP/DXF files on a deal and writes material, volume and price estimate into line items.
por_que_ahora: HubSpot marketplace is growing and manufacturers lack vertical apps.
ventaja_juan: CAD parsing and manufacturing cost knowledge.
riesgo_principal: Depends on HubSpot and few niche buyers.

cliente_que_paga: Salesforce admin at a job shop or fabricator
problema: Quotes for laser/waterjet parts are built manually outside Salesforce.
solucion: Managed package that reads DXF on an Opportunity and computes cut length, pierce count and price from a rate table.
por_que_ahora: CPQ is heavy and expensive for small fabricators on Salesforce.
ventaja_juan: DXF geometry and laser-cutting costing expertise.
riesgo_principal: AppExchange security review and ISV process effort.

problema: Need to convert and preview STEP/IGES files without building a CAD kernel.
solucion: Containerized API on AWS Marketplace converting CAD to glTF/PNG/SVG, billed via the AWS bill.
canal_primeros_100: AWS Marketplace listing for 'CAD conversion' and SEO 'step to gltf api'
por_que_ahora: Enterprises can burn AWS commits through Marketplace without procurement.
ventaja_juan: CAD formats knowledge and low-cost build.
riesgo_principal: Open-source OpenCascade DIY alternatives.

problema: PLC project files (L5X, TIA exports) are binary-ish and impossible to review in pull requests.

por_que_ahora: Industrial teams are adopting Git and CI slowly.
ventaja_juan: Direct Studio 5000 and TIA Portal experience.
riesgo_principal: Small niche and vendors may ship own versioning.

cliente_que_paga: Owner of a 3D printing service bureau using HubSpot
problema: Customers email STL files and quotes are manual.
solucion: HubSpot app with a form that analyzes STL, estimates print time and material, and creates a deal with a price.
